statement.zh: 凡一个过程的运行经映射是同一历程之处，配置数为 N 时，前段从 2N − 1 起确定它，与确定的律一样。在分开之处，没有外推，无论被给予什么（过程在内），在两个运行上都对；列出、可判定的过程中，依过程所建的外推恰在不分开之处都对。
statement.en: Wherever a process's runs have one course through the map, a prefix fixes it from 2N − 1 on with N configurations. At a parting no extrapolation, whatever it is given, is right on both runs; for listed, decided processes the one built from the process is right exactly where none part.

laws.zh: 两个运行在某步之前经映射取同一值、在该步取不同值，即在该步分开；两者在该步之前的前段是同一个，所以没有外推，无论被给予什么，在两者上都对；在从一个配置出发的每个运行上从 T 起都对的外推，使这些运行在 T 之后不分开。
laws.en: Two runs part at a step where they take one value through the map before it and different values at it; their prefixes before it are one, so no extrapolation, whatever it is given, is right on both; an extrapolation right from T on, on every run from a configuration, leaves no two of those runs parting from T on.

laws.zh: 经映射的值可判定时，从一个配置出发没有两个运行分开，恰当它们经映射的是同一历程。
laws.en: With the values through the map decided, no two runs from a configuration part exactly where all of them have one course through the map.

laws.zh: 不分开沿运行保持：把一个运行到某步为止，与从它在那一步所在处出发的任一运行相连，得到从其起点出发的运行，所以从不分开的配置出发的运行所到之处也不分开。
laws.en: Not parting is kept along runs: a run up to a step joined to any run from where it is at that step is a run from its start, so every configuration a run from an unparted configuration reaches is unparted.

laws.zh: 从不分开的配置出发、被 N 个配置的列表所持的运行，其经映射的历程至多有 N 个状态，按最小的界的外推不被给予什么，从 N + N − 1 起每步都对；N ≥ 2 时没有外推在每个这样的运行上于 N + N − 2 都对。
laws.en: On a run from an unparted configuration held by a list of N configurations the course through the map has at most N states, and the extrapolation by the least bound, given nothing, is right from N + N − 1 on; for N ≥ 2 no extrapolation is right at N + N − 2 on every such run of every process of N configurations.

laws.zh: 一个动作的确定过程处处不分开，所以确定的律是实例；不经映射显出的分支也不分开。
laws.en: A determined process with one move parts nowhere, so determined laws are the instance; a branching that does not show through the map parts nowhere either.

laws.zh: 自由分支下每个历程都是一个运行的历程；每个前段之后，两个有这一前段的运行分开，每个外推在其中一个上于下一步不对，且有一个运行使它每步都不对。
laws.en: Under free branching every course is a run's course; after every prefix two runs with that prefix part, every extrapolation is not right at the next step on one of them, and one run makes it wrong at every step.

laws.zh: 两个值上的自由分支被两个配置的列表所持，其中一个运行经映射的历程没有状态数的界。
laws.en: Free branching on two values is held by a list of two configurations, and one of its runs has a course through the map with no bound on its states.

laws.zh: 运行只在 T 步之前分开、此后不分开时，经映射的值可判定，从一个运行在 T 所在处出发没有两个运行分开；被 N 个配置所持时其历程至多 T + N 个状态，按最小的界的外推从 2(T + N) − 1 起每步都对。
laws.en: Where runs part only before step T and never after, the values through the map decided, no two runs part from where a run is at T; held by N configurations its course has at most T + N states, and the extrapolation by the least bound is right from 2(T + N) − 1 on.

laws.zh: N 个配置的列表持有每个配置时，由之有 N 步历程的配置，一步之后仍然如此：长 N 的历程重复一个配置，绕着重复可以走任意长；所以由之有任意长的历程，不用判定也不用选取。步可判定、动作列出时，由之有无尽的运行，每步取第一个仍可走下去的后继造出。
laws.en: Where a list of N holds every configuration, from where a course of N steps starts a step leads to where one starts: the course repeats a configuration and can go round; so courses of every length start there, with no decidability and no selection. With decided steps and listed moves, a run goes on from there, built by taking at each step the first successor from which one can.

laws.zh: 反方向：步与经映射的值可判定时，依过程所建的外推从前段读出运行可能所在的配置，取第一个由之可走下去者，提出它经映射的值；它在某步于从一个配置出发的每个运行上都对，恰当没有两个这样的运行在该步分开；所以某个外推在那里对，恰当没有运行在那里分开。
laws.en: The converse: with decided steps and values through the map, the extrapolation built from the process reads from the prefix the configurations a run can be at, takes the first from which a run goes on, and proposes its value through the map; it is right at a step on every run from a configuration exactly where no two of those runs part there, so some extrapolation is right there exactly where none part.

hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。各律所写者写在定理中：运行被列表所持，起点的配置不分开或从 T 起不分开；unparted_iff、leastBound_right、late_* 与 free_open 要经映射的值可判定；world_right_iff 等要动作与配置列出、步可判定；free_never_right、free_held 与 free_unbounded 陈述在两个值上。
hypotheses.en: No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: a run held by a list, a start unparted or unparted from T on; unparted_iff, leastBound_right, the late_ laws and free_open need the values through the map decided; world_right_iff and its kin need listed moves and configurations and decided steps; free_never_right, free_held and free_unbounded are stated on two values (Bool).

hypotheses.zh: 外推读配置经映射的值；动作只在映射读它们时显出（例如配置带着它的上一个动作）。
hypotheses.en: The extrapolation reads the values of configurations through the map; moves show only where the map reads them (for instance, where a configuration carries its last move).

does_not_show.zh: 配置数的界在运行分开之处不约束历程。
does_not_show.en: A bound on configurations bounds no course where runs part.

does_not_show.zh: 无限或步不可判定的过程中依过程所建的外推：构造要配置与动作列出、步可判定，那里由之能否走下去一般不可判定。
does_not_show.en: The extrapolation built from the process for infinite or undecided processes: the construction needs listed moves and configurations and decided steps, and elsewhere whether a run goes on is not decided in general.

does_not_show.zh: 2(T + N) − 1 对每个 T 是否恰好，没有表明。
does_not_show.en: Whether 2(T + N) − 1 is exact for every T is not shown.

detail.zh: free_parts_after：每个前段之后，自由分支上两个有这一前段的运行分开；free_never_right：对每个外推，自由分支上的对角运行使它每步都不对；free_unbounded：两个配置上的一个运行，其历程不是任何套索，没有状态数的界。
detail.en: free_parts_after: after every prefix two runs of free branching with that prefix part; free_never_right: for every extrapolation, the diagonal run of free branching makes it wrong at every step; free_unbounded: a run on two configurations whose course is no lasso and has no bound on its states.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261015T193101.075446Z）：Becoming.Parting 的 62 项声明（43 项定理）公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。作者反审见研究 §140 与 §150；经第十八次审查（AI，只读，未重建 Lean）审阅，其更正已处理。
validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261015T193101.075446Z): the 62 declarations of Becoming.Parting, 43 of them theorems, have empty axiom reports; the checker verifies core purity. Author counterreview in study sections 140 and 150; reviewed by the eighteenth review (AI, read-only, no Lean rebuild), whose corrections are applied.

next_delta.zh: 无限或步不可判定的过程中依过程所建的外推能对之处；2(T + N) − 1 的恰好性。
next_delta.en: Where an extrapolation built from the process can be right for infinite or undecided processes; the exactness of 2(T + N) − 1.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-15：“"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”，并说核心是覆盖有物与变化的全部实在、零公理者，且“if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly”。辨识一线对确定的律陈述，这里对每个过程。已知：分开处无外推两者都对是不可区分论证，是 Gold（1967，“Language identification in the limit”）式的对角论证；分开与区分的检验可追溯到 Moore（1956，“Gedanken-experiments on sequential machines”）。AI 的注：2026-10-12 的“the full "truth" can be derived, situationally”对经映射所读者成立，到运行不分开为止；每个情境都有界不由零公理推出。原先的 AI 读法“分开处的分支只在被走时定下”已撤回；Ren 2026-10-16：“the actual change depends on the situation … the situation makes it true”。读法（Ren 同日已取）：分开处前段与所给的律不固定的，由情境固定（weights-count-situations）。
correspondence.en: Ren, 15 October 2026: “"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”, with the core read as the whole covering all reality where things and changes exist, with zero axioms, and “if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly”. The identification line (identification-where-bounded) is stated for determined laws; this states it for every process, determined laws being one case. Known result: no extrapolation right on both at a parting is the indistinguishability argument, a diagonal argument in the style of Gold (1967, “Language identification in the limit”); parting and distinguishing tests go back to Moore (1956, “Gedanken-experiments on sequential machines”). The AI's note: “the full "truth" can be derived, situationally” (12 October) holds for what is read through the map, as far as runs do not part; that every situation is bounded is not derived with no axiom. The AI's first reading, “at a parting the branch is settled only when taken”, is withdrawn; Ren, 16 October 2026: “the actual change depends on the situation … the situation makes it true”. Read so (the AI's reading of Ren's words, which Ren took the same day): at a parting, what the prefix and the supplied law leave open the situation fixes (weights-count-situations).

detail.zh: 复用 leastBound_exact、rest_earliest、statesBelow_iff_lasso、statesBelow_mono、below_all 与 not_ne_bool：确定的律的辨识推广到每个过程中运行不分开之处。
detail.en: Reuses leastBound_exact, rest_earliest, statesBelow_iff_lasso, statesBelow_mono, below_all and not_ne_bool: identification under determined laws extended to every process where runs do not part.

output.zh: 至多 N 个状态的历程上，按最小的界的外推从 2N − 1 起都对；2N − 2 不够。
output.en: On a course with at most N states the extrapolation by the least bound is right from 2N − 1 on; 2N − 2 does not suffice.

input.zh: 不分开的运行经映射的历程至多有 N 个状态。
input.en: The course through the map of an unparted run has at most N states.

detail.zh: 复用 prefixOf、prefix_congr、holdFrom、diagonal、diagonal_misses、diagonal_not_lasso、byElimination 与 lassos：自由分支上的对角与开放。
detail.en: Reuses prefixOf, prefix_congr, holdFrom, diagonal, diagonal_misses, diagonal_not_lasso, byElimination and lassos: the diagonal and openness on free branching.

output.zh: 对每个外推都有一个使它提出的每个值都不合的历程，且它不是套索。
output.en: For every extrapolation a course on which each value it proposes misses, and it is no lasso.

input.zh: 这一历程是自由分支的一个运行。
input.en: That course is a run of free branching.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.realized_within：至多 N 个状态的历程是 N 个配置上的律的历程，给出对过程的恰好。
detail.en: Reuses Law.realized_within: a course with at most N states is the course of a law on N configurations, giving exactness for processes.

output.zh: Fin N 上的律、映射与起点，其经映射的历程是给定的历程。
output.en: A law, a map and a start on Fin N whose course through the map is the given course.

input.zh: 一个动作的确定过程的不分开的运行。
input.en: An unparted run of a determined process with one move.

detail.zh: 复用 revisits_within、Law.process 与 Law.orbit：被列表所持的运行在列表长度之内复现一个配置。
detail.en: Reuses revisits_within, Law.process and Law.orbit: a run held by a list revisits a configuration within the list's length.

output.zh: 被长 N 的列表所持的序列在 N 之内有两处相同。
output.en: A sequence held by a list of length N repeats within N.

input.zh: 运行在两处有同一配置，从那里起经映射的历程相同。
input.en: A run at one configuration twice, the courses through the map from there agreeing.

detail.zh: 复用 StatesBelow、SameAhead 与 statesBelow_of_same：两个时刻是同一状态时，历程至多有后者那么多状态。
detail.en: Reuses StatesBelow, SameAhead and statesBelow_of_same: where two moments are one state, the course has at most as many states as the later.

output.zh: 同一状态的两个时刻给出状态数的界。
output.en: Two moments of one state give a bound on states.

input.zh: 复现的配置给出同一状态的两个时刻。
input.en: A revisited configuration gives two moments of one state.

detail.zh: 复用 Lasting.Continues 与 Lasting.Unbounded：由一个配置出发有多长的历程。
detail.en: Reuses Lasting.Continues and Lasting.Unbounded: how long the courses from a configuration are.

output.zh: 有 n 步的历程从 s 出发；每个长度的历程都从 s 出发。
output.en: Some course of n steps starts at s; courses of every length do.

input.zh: 配置有限时，N 步的历程给出任意长的历程，不用判定；依过程所建的外推取由之可走下去的配置。
input.en: With finitely many configurations, a course of N steps gives courses of every length, with no decidability; the extrapolation built from the process takes a configuration from which a run goes on.

conditions.zh: 一个列表持有每个配置。

detail.zh: 映射的限度：经映射的未来相同的配置给每个外推同样的前段；这里是经映射的过去相同的运行。
detail.en: The map's limit: configurations with the same future through the map give every extrapolation the same prefix; here, runs with the same past through the map.

detail.zh: 动作造成什么只在被走之处由记录固定；这里分开处的分支，前段与所给的律都不固定（“只在被走时定下”的读法已撤回）。
detail.en: What an act does is fixed by the record only where taken; here neither the prefix nor the supplied law fixes the branch at a parting (the reading “settled only when taken” is withdrawn).

detail.zh: 同一些分支过程的返回与吸入；这里是其中的辨识。
detail.en: Returning and drawing for the same branching processes; here, identification in them.

detail.zh: 有权重的世界：记录不显示权重，计数给出多数历程显示权重。
detail.en: Worlds with weights: a record shows no weight, and counting gives that most courses show the weights.

detail.zh: 分开处前段与律不固定的由情境固定：以情境为动作，律是确定的。
detail.en: What the prefix and the law leave open at a parting the situation fixes: with the situation as the move, the law is determined.

history.zh: 2026-10-16 P119：按 Ren 2026-10-16 的“take 2, and do the open proofs”，加三条规律（只在 T 步之前分开时的静止之步；由之可走下去的配置；反方向，被给予世界的学习者）；statement、hypotheses 第一项、does_not_show（反方向与静止之步两项已证，移去）与 next_delta 改写；研究 §150。原 statement 的第二句：“在分开之处，下一个值只在被走时定下：学习者无论被给予什么（世界在内），至多在两个运行之一上对。” 之后同日：改以 Lasting.Continues 陈述可走下去（live_iff_continues），配置有限时 N 步的历程给出任意长的历程，不用判定（unbounded_of_continues）；Parting 导入 Lasting；dependencies 加 lifting-where-branching-is-finite。
history.en: 16 October 2026, P119: following Ren's “take 2, and do the open proofs” of 16 October, three laws added (the rest step where runs part only before T; configurations from which a run goes on; the converse, with the learner given the world); statement, the first hypothesis, does_not_show (the converse and the rest step, now proved, removed) and next_delta rewritten; study section 150. The former second sentence of the statement: “At a parting the next value is settled only when taken: a learner, whatever it is given, the world included, is right on at most one of the two runs.” Later the same day: going on is stated through Lasting.Continues (live_iff_continues), and with finitely many configurations a course of N steps gives courses of every length, with no decidability (unbounded_of_continues); Parting imports Lasting; dependencies gain lifting-where-branching-is-finite.

Re-pointed after reading the change: BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md, section 223 added; Description.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged; Identification.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged; Learning.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged; Parting.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged; Prelude.lean, twelve statements stated in two or more modules each, stated here once under the name kept; Recurrence.lean, pure forwarders and copies removed (B10, B9), uses pointed at the law they restate; imports follow the folds; kept statements unchanged; THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md, §9 (receipt, counts, connectivity under the measure that no longer counts restatement) follows R32. The claim is unchanged.
